name: Alliance Movers
summary: Local and regional moving support for apartment and condo shifts — lift bookings, packing waste, and inventory discipline without full-container corporate freight.
body: For intra-island condo moves, local movers can be more proportionate than full international freight agents. Still insist on a written inventory, insurance clarity, and lift/padding bookings coordinated with condo management — weekday-only slots are common. If any unaccompanied overseas boxes are in the mix, confirm Singapore Customs GST-relief steps separately; domestic movers may not handle Declaration of Facts. Photograph meter readings and existing damage on both ends so aircon brackets and flooring disputes do not become deposit fights.
